references.text: David expresses trust in God to provide for basic needs, which is similar to the trust Jesus encourages in Matthew 6:32.
God knows and answers the needs of His people before they pray, paralleling God's understanding of our needs in Matthew 6:32.
God's promise to provide for His people in the land, reflecting God's care for our needs in Matthew 6:32.
The call to be content with what one has, because God has said He will never leave or forsake us, which resonates with the assurance of God's care in Matthew 6:32.
